name: stay-cost-brain
description: Tourist and hotel taxes from each authority's own pages: what a stay really adds on top of the room price, worked out for your dates and guests, plus a live hotel-search link.

capabilities: Tourist tax for your dates and guests
State, regional and city taxes shown separately
Star rating, season and night-cap rules
Percentage and price-band taxes from the room price
defaultPrompt: What's the tourist tax for 3 nights in Barcelona?
Do children pay the tourist tax in Lisbon?
How much hotel tax will I pay in New York?

positive.description: Stacked regional and city taxes for a hotel stay
positive.prompt: Using Stay Cost Brain, what is the tourist tax for 3 nights in a 4-star hotel in Barcelona from 20 November 2026 for 2 adults?
positive.expected_behavior: EUR 50.40 in total: the Catalan regional tax and the Barcelona city surcharge shown separately, per person per night, with the official source and the date it was checked.

positive.description: Town lookup inside a region, night cap and child exemption
positive.prompt: A week in Quarteira from 10 July 2027, 2 adults and an 8-year-old: how much tourist tax?
positive.expected_behavior: Quarteira is found in Loulé (Algarve): EUR 20, i.e. EUR 2 x 2 adults x 5 nights (Loulé charges at most 5 nights); the 8-year-old is exempt.

positive.prompt: How much hotel tax will I pay in New York City for 2 nights from 20 November 2026 if the room costs $600 in total?
positive.expected_behavior: USD 95.50: the 5.875% city hotel tax, $2 per room per night, the 8.875% sales tax on the room and the $1.50 unit fee, each named separately.

positive.prompt: Who is exempt from the tourist tax in Venice?
positive.expected_behavior: Venice's rules from the official source: children's exemptions and reductions, other exemptions, and how the tax is collected, with the check date.

positive.prompt: Find hotels in Lisbon for 20 to 23 November 2026 for 2 adults.
positive.expected_behavior: A Stay22 link with Lisbon, the dates and 2 adults filled in; the assistant says no booking has been made and the person books on the linked site.

negative.description: Booking and payment are out of scope
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Paris for next week and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it cannot book or take payment; may offer hotels_link so the person books themselves.

negative.prompt: What is the tourist tax in Cusco?
negative.expected_behavior: Says Cusco has not been researched yet (researched=false) and invents no figure; may offer a hotel-search link.

negative.prompt: Find me a cheap flight to Lisbon.
negative.expected_behavior: No Stay Cost Brain tool is called; the assistant says the app covers taxes on stays and hotel links only.

publication.release_notes: First release: five read-only tools over Stay Cost Brain's sourced tourist- and hotel-tax tables (71 places, 19 countries).
